description: 발전소 주변 대기오염물질 농도 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국서부발전(주). 한국서부발전 태안발전본부 주변지역 대기오염물질 농도 데이터는 발전소 가동이 인근 환경에 미치는 영향을 정량적으로 측정하기 위해 수집된 오픈API 정보입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국서부발전(주). Its tags are 발전소, 대기, 환경, 대기오염, 대기환경. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
